conditions.text: Reproduce on app version 3.2.0, iOS 18.4, device iPhone15,2 — these matched in every event considered.

Push was deliverable in all events, with OS permission ALLOWED and provider registration REGISTERED, and the profile was consistent; these held in every event, though the packet does not say whether they are causally required.
The pre-tap navigation path is not required to be any particular one: it varies from a single /home navigation to 12 news pages or 98 search pages across the three events.
Breadcrumbs were truncated in 1 of the events, so the recorded prefix for that event may be incomplete.
Commit c32a444 ("MEI-52: Local news feed paging") touches src/modules/news/feed.ts, the same file as the culprit frame, so it is a lead worth checking rather than a confirmed cause.

missing_evidence_questions.text: What did the truncated breadcrumb trail contain for the affected event, and does it change the shared prefix before the tap?
What article content or response payload was loaded at /news/article in each event, since the packet records no data about what failed to parse?
Does the failure reproduce on app versions other than 3.2.0, on iOS versions other than 18.4, or on devices other than iPhone15,2, none of which appear in the observed events?
Did commit c32a444 change the loadPage path at src/modules/news/feed.ts:88, and does reverting or bypassing that change stop the error?
Are the push and profile preconditions incidental to these 3 events or actually needed to trigger the parse failure?

steps_prose.text: Get the app into the state shown by the events; the browsing that precedes the failure differs per event, so any of the observed prefixes will do: 12 steps of news paging from /news/0 through /news/11, 98 steps of search paging from /search/0 through /search/97, or a single NAVIGATE to /home.
Tap an article link (a.article-link); this step is present in all 3 events.
Let the app navigate to /news/article, which is also present in all 3 events.
Observe the failure: Error "Article body parse failed" surfacing in loadPage at src/modules/news/feed.ts line 88.

summary.text: Across 3 events, an Error "Article body parse failed" is thrown in loadPage at src/modules/news/feed.ts:88 after the user taps an article link and navigates to /news/article.
